implementation: via_obstacle_axis_exits: derive four axis-only obstacle-centre proposals from the same pad-edge and drill-centre clearance rules as via_site_blocker
purpose: Geometric candidate kernel for targeted opposite-side thermal repair, avoiding arbitrary search radii or padding

coverage: GND hole-to-pad clearance versus non-GND via-to-pad clearance
drill hole-to-hole clearance with and without drilled obstacles
rectangular pad extents in both orientations
every returned proposal clears the isolated obstacle under the actual checker
one-micrometre inward move violates clearance, detecting unjustified padding
another unchanged obstacle still blocks the site
unblocked pads and board-edge violations generate no proposals

limitations: Candidate generation only, not wired into production placement yet. Returned positions require emitted-grid projection and complete board legality checks. No new accepted layout or performance claim. Existing board output unchanged by this uncalled kernel.
